model:
AMZN business-model profile (AI compute lens), refreshed 30 October 2026. Sources: 2025 10-K, 3Q26 release (29 October 2026), 3Q26 10-Q.

1. Engine: Amazon turns retail and ads cash flow plus investment-grade debt (now including secured equipment finance) into data centers, chips and power, and rents that capacity through AWS on multi-year commitments. Its stakes in Anthropic and OpenAI double as anchor tenants.

2. Revenue map: AWS revenue = energized GW x utilization x price per unit of compute. Backlog (RPO): $244bn (4Q25), $364bn (1Q26), $496bn (2Q26), $578bn (3Q26), weighted life 6.1 years. AWS $46.0bn in 3Q26 (+39.3%; $184bn run rate); management projects over 40% growth in 2027 and 2028. Trainium to be sold outside AWS from late 2027.

3. Costs: depreciation drives margins. AWS D&A $9.23bn in 3Q26 (+63%), 20.1% of AWS revenue; AWS margin 38.7% (energy-derivative gain only $91mn). Management says it is extending useful lives and shortening break-even (servers 5-6 years). Power: energy contracts of about 690mn MWh, ~18-year duration. Component (memory) prices are a stated headwind.

4. Funding: 2026 cash capex about $220bn (9M $172.2bn; 3Q $75.9bn); 2027 'meaningfully more'. AWS took 73% of 3Q property additions. OCF $168.3bn TTM against TTM FCF of -$42.4bn (3Q alone -$33.5bn). Face debt $180.9bn (year-end $68.8bn), including the $17.5bn term loan drawn in September (SOFR + 0.625-0.875%); new secured supplier loan facility of up to ~$80bn (Q1 2027 to Q3 2028, five-year borrowings); $20bn revolvers renewed October 2026; $30bn CP undrawn. A1/AA/AA-. Leases not yet commenced $164.9bn; total commitments $883.6bn. Parent rent guarantee at Cipher Stingray.

5. Sensitivities: power delivery timing, AI pricing (long-term contract discounts), memory inflation, server lives, lab credit, bond spreads, and Anthropic marks ($238.7bn carrying value).

6. Position: largest cloud; Trainium and Graviton commitments up more than 20x; multi-GW lab commitments; prefers owned or long-leased capacity and says neocloud capacity is ~3,500bp worse in operating margin. Building on-site gas (GW Ranch) and signing nuclear deals. Rivals: Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle, neoclouds.

7. Breakers: the backlog stalls on power or chips; a lab cuts its commitments; AI prices fall faster than costs; capex outruns OCF and spreads widen or ratings slip; server lives shorten.
name: Amazon
